issue_title: [Bug] Race condition in add operation: load-compute-save pattern without locking leads
summary: Fixed race condition in add operation by implementing file-based locking using fcntl.flock around the load-compute-save sequence

implementation_details.approach: Added file-based exclusive locking (fcntl.flock) around the load-compute-save sequence in atomic_add method
key_changes: Added _acquire_lock() and _release_lock() methods to TodoStorage class
Added atomic_add() method that acquires lock, loads, assigns ID, saves, and releases lock
Modified TodoApp.add() to use storage.atomic_add() instead of direct load-compute-save pattern
Added regression test test_concurrent_add_no_duplicate_ids() to verify no duplicate IDs or lost todos in concurrent scenarios

risks_limitations: Uses Unix-specific fcntl.flock - not portable to Windows (would need msvcrt.locking or portalocker)
Lock file (.json.lock) is created alongside data file
If process crashes while holding lock, stale lock file may remain (but will be overwritten on next operation)
